notes.title: Swordbreaker: Origins. Announcement of the prequel game Swordbreaker!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10709381/9020f1e4c6efff163ad22a85254930ee31a55a99.jpg
Hello dears!
We started work on a new text game - Swordbreaker!
Illustrated text adventure "Swordbreakerl: Origins" is the prequel to the first text Swordbreaker. The events of the game will tell about our hero from his childhood. You will learn who he is, where and how he lived and how he came to such a life. And, of course, you will know his name!
In the game you will have to wait for a lot of fun, scary, strange and just interesting events. As usual, you can influence the fate of the hero and lead him to his ending. Perhaps he will be exactly the adventurer you saw in the first game, and maybe it will be a completely different fate. Everything depends on you.
We have taken into account all your comments and suggestions for the last game, so many points will be seriously improved or redone.
What's new in this game:
- I absolutely in a different way approached to creation of subject branches, optimized them and now there will be no cheater reductions of a plot. Also branches will be more evenly distributed on the map.
- The game will be a little more text. The text became more correct, without inappropriate words.
- There will be mini-games! They will not be much, but they will diversify the gameplay.
- More endings! Now their not 3, and 8!!! The main endings will be, as usual, 3 endings of karma (Hero, Killer, Coward). Plus, the player can perform some action and plot to go in a completely different ending! Should be very interesting!
- More music! Well, its quality will be much better)
- Completely redesigned interface, where everything will be more convenient for the player.
In General, we will keep you informed!

Hello dears!
While the new Swordbreaker is still in development, we decided to make a new small game for you. This is not just a game, but a game that develops memory and intelligence! This is our new quiz game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/905150/Trivia_Quiz_All_about_everything/
Add to wishlist!):GoldenCoinFromOldCastle:

- Geography
- An amazing series
- Biology
- Cosmos
- Chemistry
- IT

Themes will be periodically replenished and added new ones! Therefore, taking a game once, everything else will get free!

The genre is unusual for the Steam, but quite interesting and does not require a powerful computer. Here the main tool is your brain!

notes.title: First patch
notes.content:
So here it is! Some bugs fixed: 
 - grammar mistakes
 - chief crash (eng version)
 - falcon crash (eng version)
 - Don't touch Gans achivment fixed
 + added change screen mode option in main menu

Some bugs are still in progress: 
 - wrong display on some resolutions (you can play through using windowed mode in full screen right now, it works well)
 - some users have problems with run on 32-bit systems.

Итак первый пакет исправлений вышел: 
 - поправлены некоторые грамматические ошибки
 - исправлены вылеты в английской версии
 - исправлен баг с получением достижения "Не трожь Ганса!"
 + добавлен режим игры в окне, для тех, у кого имеются проблемы с разрешением экрана.
